caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair with a curved high back and a padded seat. The frame of the chair is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a polished wood finish, with the grain of the wood visible in the illustration. The seat and backrest are upholstered with a fabric that appears to have a woven pattern in muted tones of beige and light brown, with some subtle reddish or purple linear accents indicating the woven texture. The chair has two curved rockers at the bottom that support its structure and enable the rocking motion. The armrests are wooden, and the overall design of the chair is simple, with clean lines and a functional form. The chair is centered on a light-colored, plain background with no additional objects or visual elements present.
title: Shaker Rocking Chair
